items.title: 🍎 Fall fun is in full swing at WES! Mrs. Bowersox's young fives and kindergarten students just celebrated Apple Day…
items.excerpt: with hands-on learning, including tasting different apple products, using apples to measure and compare items, and estimating how many apples tall they are. Great work, students! Your creativity is off the charts!⭐

items.title: Big shout-out to the Newland-Trimble American Legion Post 615 for making a trip to our campus to donate not one but two…
items.excerpt: American flags! The flags are already proudly on display, one at Waynesville Elementary and the other at our Performing Arts Center. Be sure to check them out when you're on campus next! 🇺🇸We appreciate Post 615 for its generosity and continued support of our district!🧡

items.title: Waynesville Elementary's Goodies with Grands event brought our preschoolers and their grandparents or special guests…
items.excerpt: together to celebrate learning, make memories, and kick off the school year with connection.🧡🖤 Because at Wayne Local Schools, belonging includes our families, too! #YouBelong #WeAreWayneLocal

items.title: 🔎WLS Fiscal Focus: Who Checks the Books? Our 2025–2026 annual audit is officially underway! So, what exactly does that…
items.excerpt: mean? 🍎Public schools in Ohio are audited by the Ohio Auditor of State at least once every two years. Think of it as having an independent set of eyes take a very close look at our financial homework. 🗂️Auditors review financial statements, records, transactions, and supporting documentation…

The fun doesn’t stop here, our next goal is $40,000 to earn recess with Mr. Sparks! Can we get him out there swinging, sliding and playing ball…
